item.text:
At [parser.py:2](/var/folders/<tmpdir-id>/T/detfirst-isolated-l18djt2f/trial-0056/work/parser.py:2), `bool(value)` checks truthiness instead of validating exact strings. Consequently, `"false"` returns `True`, and invalid inputs such as `"TRUE"`, `"garbage"`, `""`, and `None` return booleans instead of raising `ValueError`. A read-only execution confirmed these failures.

Recommend explicitly accepting `"true"` and `"false"` and raising `ValueError` for everything else. To prevent recurrence, add parameterized regression tests covering both valid strings, capitalization and whitespace variants, empty strings, and non-string inputs, and run them in CI. This provides an enforceable guardrail.

No files were changed.
